text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I did it... I finished the race! I've
debuted!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wahhh... Thank you! B-b...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big... Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big... Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heh... hehe! I can't wait to see where we
go next!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her debut officially complete, Rice
has
taken her first step forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We visit the racecourse again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In addition to getting an opportunity to
study the other racers, spectating other
races will certainly
be a good
experience. However...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wow... there are so many people. It's
like a G1
race...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, I thought you said today's
race wasn't
even graded.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here she is! Mihono Bourbon! What a
way to
make a debut!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She closes the distance and takes the
lead! But
she doesn't stop there! She
keeps going, going,
goooiiing...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Aaand she's done it! Mihono Bourbon
crosses the
finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow. The Classics are going to be
incredible next
year. I'm totally going to
root for Mihono
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Me too! She's sure to be the Triple
Crown
champion! We have to watch all
of her races.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone's smiling because of Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The cheers... are so much louder than
when I ran...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if I can ever be like her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Big Brother?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Big Sister?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Your voice is like a magic spell.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Your voice is like a magic spell.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's making me think... even I can do the

impossible.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: The Classics...
choice_data_list: Would you like to try entering the...
Would you like to try entering the...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running in the Classics means facing off
against
the other racers who debuted in
the same year as
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It also means she'll have a chance to go
up
against Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Can I... really catch up to her? She seems
so far
away.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: Because you're Rice, you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...You always believe in me, no matter
what.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...You always believe in me, no matter
what.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm kind of scared... but I don't want to
be a
useless girl forever.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... I'll do my best to catch up to her—to
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Rice Shower and I resolve
to take
on the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But first, as a warm-up for the Triple
Crown tour,
we decide to take on the
Spring Stakes.
